{"text":"ItemID: NA; Title: Siglent Technologies SDS1202X-E 200 mhz Digital Oscilloscope 2 Channels, Grey; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My electronics projects fit the general purpose, but I have no current need for an oscilloscope.
ItemID: NA; Title: Sumnacon 5pcs Banana to Banana Plug Test Lead Set, 4mm Stackable Banana Plug Wire Test Cable Lead for Multimeter, Electrical Test Wire 1000V/15A; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Useful bench accessories, but my history does not establish that I have equipment with matching sockets.
ItemID: NA; Title: Iverntech MGN12H 400mm Linear Rail Guide with 2 Stainless Steel Carriage Blocks for Ender 3, Corexy, Tronxy, Delta Kossel 3D Printers Upgrades and CNC Machine; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Buying casters does not mean I need precision motion hardware, and I have no established printer upgrade project.
ItemID: NA; Title: EDGELEC 100pcs 220 ohm Resistor 1/2w (0.5Watt) ±1% Tolerance Metal Film Fixed Resistor, Multiple Values of Resistance Optional; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: These fit the breadboard and LED projects suggested by my component purchases, so I would choose a pack.
ItemID: NA; Title: BNTECHGO 34 AWG Magnet Wire - Enameled Copper Wire - Enameled Magnet Winding Wire - 2 oz - 0.0063" Diameter 1 Spool Coil Natural Temperature Rating 155℃ Widely Used for Transformers Inductors; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: My ferrite toroid cores make winding wire relevant; I would try this for small coil experiments after checking the wire gauge.
ItemID: NA; Title: Koolertron Upgraded 15MHz DDS Signal Generator Counter,High Precision Dual-Channel Arbitrary Waveform Function Generator Frequency Meter 200MSa/s (15MHz); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My component purchases suggest tinkering, but no current waveform testing task justifies choosing this instrument.
ItemID: NA; Title: DC Power Supply Variable 30V 10A, 4-Digital LED Display, Precision Adjustable Switching Regulated Multifunctional Power Supply Digital with USB Interface, Disply with Output Power Lab Grade; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Adjustable power could be useful, but my battery holder and small modules do not establish a need for this bench supply right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: DIYMAG Neodymium Magnets with Hole, 100LBS Heavy Duty Round Base Cup Magnets for Wall, Rare Earth Magnets with Countersunk Hole and Stainless Screws for Hanging, Office, Craft-Dia 1.26 inch-Pack of 8; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have bought fasteners, but I do not currently have a mounting task that calls for strong cup magnets.
ItemID: NA; Title: EDGELEC 100pcs 5mm White Lights LED Diodes Clear Round Lens 29mm Long Lead (DC 3V) +100pcs Resistors (for DC 6-12V) Included, Bright Bulb Lamps Light Emitting Diode; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: LEDs with matching resistors suit my breadboard and PCB tinkering, so I would choose these for simple lighting experiments.
ItemID: NA; Title: HATCHBOX 1.75mm Orange PLA 3D Printer Filament, 1 KG Spool, Dimensional Accuracy +/- 0.03 mm, 3D Printing Filament; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Nothing in my recent purchases establishes that I use a 3D printer or need orange filament."}
